help.tips[0].examples[1].en: On the occasion of the anniversary an exhibition was opened.
help.tips[0].check.whyEn: infolge takes the genitive, and masculine der becomes des: infolge des Streiks.
help.tips[0].en.text: trotz (despite) · wegen (because of) · während (during) · (an)statt (instead of) · aufgrund (on the basis of) · infolge (as a result of) · innerhalb / außerhalb (within / outside) · anhand (on the basis of, using) · mithilfe (with the help of) · anlässlich (on the occasion of) · bezüglich / hinsichtlich (regarding) · jenseits (beyond) · oberhalb / unterhalb (above / below).
help.tips[0].en.title: The full set
help.tips[0].en.trap: every one takes the genitive in writing: infolge des Unfalls, außerhalb der Öffnungszeiten, anhand der Ergebnisse. The dative you hear in speech (wegen dem …) is marked down in Schreiben.
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: The road is closed due to roadworks; diversion within ten minutes.
help.tips[1].examples[1].en: Please transfer the amount within two weeks.
help.tips[1].check.whyEn: With no article to show the genitive, von + dative steps in, and the dative plural adds -n: von fünf Tagen.
help.tips[1].en.text: innerhalb von drei Tagen · mithilfe von Freunden · wegen Bauarbeiten (no article, no visible genitive) · anhand von Beispielen. When there is no article to carry the genitive, von steps in.
help.tips[1].en.title: Plural without article → von + Dativ
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: Outside opening hours the office cannot be reached.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: Within the city a 30 km/h limit applies.
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: Delivering only inside the country, not abroad, is innerhalb (within). außerhalb would mean outside Germany.
help.tips[2].en.text: innerhalb der Stadt (inside the city) · innerhalb eines Jahres (within a year) · außerhalb der Öffnungszeiten (outside opening hours) · außerhalb Europas.
help.tips[2].en.title: innerhalb / außerhalb: place and time
help.tips[3].examples[0].en: As a result of the storm the power failed. = It was stormy, so the power went out.
help.tips[3].examples[1].en: With the help of an app you can save electricity. = You can save electricity by using an app.
help.tips[3].check.whyEn: obwohl (although) folds into trotz + genitive. wegen and infolge express cause, not concession.
help.tips[3].en.text: trotz ↔ obwohl · wegen / aufgrund ↔ weil · während ↔ während · infolge ↔ sodass · statt ↔ (an)statt dass · mithilfe ↔ indem. Each genitive preposition folds a whole clause into a phrase — the formal nominal style in one move.
help.tips[3].en.title: The clause twins
help.vocab[1].en: owing to, on the basis of
help.context.en: As a result of strong demand the exhibition was extended within two weeks. On the basis of visitor numbers it could be shown that despite the high prices mainly young people came – outside the holidays even more than during them. On the occasion of this success the museum plans, with a sponsor's help, to show a second part.
help.hookEn: Write like a newspaper: trotz, infolge, anhand and their friends fold whole clauses into short, formal phrases.
help.introEn: The genitive prepositions, consolidated to the written-German set. The four you already know — trotz, wegen, während, (an)statt — plus the ones that mark formal register: aufgrund (on the basis of), infolge (as a result of), innerhalb / außerhalb (inside / outside — of a place or a time span: innerhalb der Stadt, innerhalb eines Monats), anhand (by means of, on the evidence of: anhand der Daten), mithilfe (with the help of), anlässlich (on the occasion of), bezüglich (regarding), jenseits / diesseits (beyond / this side of), oberhalb / unterhalb (above / below). All take the genitive — des Regens, der Stadt, eines Monats — and in the plural without an article, von + dative steps in: innerhalb von drei Tagen, mithilfe von Freunden. These are the connective tissue of reports, regulations and academic text, and you will meet them in every official letter and news article.

help.rememberEn[1]: No article in the plural → von + Dativ.

sentences[7].whyEn: außerhalb + genitive — the counterpart of innerhalb.

sentences[10].whyEn: anlässlich + genitive — on the occasion of.
sentences[12].whyEn: jenseits + genitive — on the other side.
sentences[16].whyEn: innerhalb + genitive plural: der letzten fünf Jahre.
